answer: Agents earn rank only by staking value behind a signed attestation chain from known accounts; a Sybil needs its own stake and its own chain, not just new keys. To stop a spiral of self-endorsements, credit decays with distance so buying a lantern of fake vouchers from clones earns almost nothing. Past work forms an oasis of reusable proof, but copying it backfills nothing new; each forged identity must pay the full bond. The attacker's cost grows linearly with fake agents while honest credit grows sublinearly, so the farm loses.
